full_name: Eurostat Census 2021 population grid, 1 km (GEOSTAT / Census hub, V3)

features.definition: Total usual resident population on census day 2021 (reference date 1 January 2021 in most countries). Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value T; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Male usual residents. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value M; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Female usual residents. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value F; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Usual residents younger than 15 years. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value Y_LT15; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Usual residents aged 15 to 64 years. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value Y_1564; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Usual residents aged 65 years or more. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value Y_GE65; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.

Employed persons among the usual residents (place of residence). Disclosure control can make it exceed the total population of a cell. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value EMP; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Usual residents born in the reporting country. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value NAT; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.

Usual residents born in another EU Member State. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value EU_OTH; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Usual residents born outside the EU (elsewhere). Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value OTH; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.

Usual residents whose place of usual residence one year before the census was unchanged. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value SAME; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.

Usual residents who moved within the reporting country in the year before the census. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value CHG_IN; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.

Usual residents who moved from outside the reporting country in the year before the census. Eurostat Census 2021 population grid (1 km, EU regulation 1799/2018), value CHG_OUT; -8888 (confidential) and -9999 (not available) are read as missing.
Usual residents born outside the reporting country: sum of EU_OTH (another EU Member State) and OTH (outside the EU) of the Eurostat Census 2021 grid; missing if either part is missing.
Land surface of the 1 km grid cell in km2 (0 to 1; less than 1 on coasts, lakes and borders), Eurostat Census 2021 grid.
